newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Bansud says Banamex to increase stake.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Bansud says Banamex to increase stake.

text.p: Argentina's Bansud, controlled by Banco Nacional de Mexico SA (Banamex), said Banamex agreed to buy from Banamex's unit Euroamerican Capital Corp the 28 percent stake Euroamerican has in Bansud for $139 million.

The deal comprises the sale of Bansud's 4.1 million class A shares with five voting rights each and 8.3 million class B shares with one voting right each owned by Euroamerican, Bansud told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange Monday.
The price will be paid once Argentina's Central Bank authorizes the deal, it added.
Banamex has a 57 percent stake in Bansud wich allows it 69 percent voting power.
